text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that <chrname> would be interviewed 
by "Monthly Twinkle."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you intend to take on the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe in that racing outfit 
as well...!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you galloping across the turf of 
Longchamp, <chrname>...! I can already picture it 
before my eyes...!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to that time as well
I'm looking forward to that time as well.

Yes, I'm sure she'll cross the finish line 
in first place.
Please come interview us then, too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you galloping across the turf of 
Longchamp, <chrname>...! I can already picture it 
before my eyes...!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to that time as well
I'm looking forward to that time as well.

Yes, I'm sure she'll cross the finish line 
in first place.
Please come interview us then, too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you also firmly believe that she 
will whip up a whirlwind at the 'Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe', Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're saying you can already see <chrname> 
holding up the trophy on the podium!?!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now THAT is the mindset a Trainer 
challenging the world's greatest stage 
needs! I am truly in awe...!!

That's right. <chrname> and I are about to take on 
a magnificent dream—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You have to possess the vision that with 
this kind of strength, you can win the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her example, they resolved to 
imagine <chrname> holding up the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe trophy every single day from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Believing wholeheartedly in your partner 
Umamusume's victory is what makes a true 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now THAT is the mindset a Trainer 
challenging the world's greatest stage 
needs! I am truly in awe...!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the interview ended up being a 
roaring success.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!! You're saying we mustn't miss the 
historic moment where we achieve greatness 
at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To record every step of that glorious path 
and broadcast it to all of Japan... is a 
mission entrusted to me...?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, of course!! When that happens, I'll 
be there in person to get the very first 
interview...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I must prepare to leave for 
France at once...! I should secure my 
plane tickets right this instant...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While asking to hold off on booking the 
flight tickets for now, thoughts wandered 
toward the day when this promise would 
become reality.
